article.headline: Auburn hosts No. 12 Arizona following Kharchenkov's 20-point outing
article.title: Auburn hosts No. 12 Arizona following Kharchenkov's 20-point outing
article.linkText: Auburn hosts No. 12 Arizona following Kharchenkov's 20-point outing
article.story: Arizona Wildcats (2-1) at Auburn Tigers (2-0) Auburn, Alabama; Friday, 9 p.m. EST LINE: Wildcats -2.5; over/under is 159.5 BOTTOM LINE: No. 12 Arizona plays Auburn after Ivan Kharchenkov scored 20 points in Arizona's 90-59 victory against the Northern Arizona Lumberjacks. Auburn went 22-16 overall a season ago while going 14-4 at home. The Tigers allowed opponents to score 78.8 points per game and shoot 46.4% from the field last season. Arizona finished 36-3 overall a season ago while going 9-1 on the road. The Wildcats averaged 86.2 points per game while shooting 49.9% from the field and 36.6% from deep last season. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
